_source: Captured from a live kind cluster running kube-prometheus-stack (chart 88.1.3, Prometheus v0.93.0, kube-state-metrics, node-exporter) and Grafana Loki 3.6.11 with promtail 3.5.1. Faults: a 96Mi container OOMKilled repeatedly, a 20m-CPU busy loop, and a crashlooping logger.

known_absent._why: Metric names that are correct but resolve to nothing on a stock kube-prometheus-stack + node-exporter deployment. Captured so the defect stays documented: container_spec.* is dropped wholesale by the kubelet ServiceMonitor for cardinality, and node-exporter series carry instance/job but never a node label.
